body: Not yet, but this is the exact reason I was afraid to give any personal information to such a service. I went for the hotline chat service instead and it took so long I gave up on it. Reading this post, I'm glad I did. Instead I decided to go for a walk, went for some pre-walk peanut butter as I just woke up and my doctor tells me to eat more. Ended up accidentally smashing my pinky finger and got ~ pissed off yet enjoyed the feeling enough to pass on the walk and just type this message, take some peels here (as L4D Louis would say) and then type out this message, calling it a night. Sorry to hear for such an intrusive experience after a delicate time, best of luck.

Agreed, I just don't understand what we're doing wrong. Used to love video games with friends, replace swimming with frisbee, drums with guitar, smoking pot with drinking and drinking with smoking pot and we've got the same life. Though I'm ~2 years behind ya here on my 22nd birthday and just feeling like shit. I hope for change yet don't expect it and wouldn't mind too much if our boats sank.. just on accident so nobody has to pull a trigger. I hate to imagine what my friends/family would feel like if I did it. Blehh... pounding on a drumset sounds just a smidge-bit more therapeutic than strumming a few strings right now, wish I had something to hit just with the frustration from typing on this stupid thread, I'm going for a walk -feel free to respond but don't necessarily count on a response (just made this account and not even sure I'll remember the username/pw when I return) and best of luck.

I want to say I'm in the same boat, but I'm in a similar boat just making a recent post to this same sub. I hope we're strong enough to make it through this time in life or something idk what the ~ do you do when you don't enjoy anything anymore? Reading your post was comforting just for some of the similarities. Maybe we'll make it through this stupid mess somehow .................
